title: Vibrant Light Ethiopian Lettuce Dabo
description: A comforting, tangy, and light Ethiopian-inspired dish using iceberg lettuce, perfect for a plant-based-friendly meal. Serve in a Korean-style brass bowl for added flair.
instructions: In a large pot, bring 2 cups of water to a boil over high heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of ghee or vegan butter to prevent sticking.
Add 1 medium chopped onion to the pot and cook for 3 minutes.
Add 2 cloves minced garlic and 1-inch grated ginger to the pot and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add 1 teaspoon berbere spice and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add 2 heads of iceberg lettuce to the pot, folding in the spices and onion mixture.
Cook for 4-5 minutes, or until the lettuce is tender but still crisp.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the lettuce mixture to a large Korean-style brass bowl.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Optional: Add 2 tablespoons of ghee or vegan butter on top of the lettuce for added richness.
